pages.text: {{hero}} likes big trucks best of all. Each day, {{hero}} rides in a green dump truck with Jake. Jake is kind, and he lets {{hero}} ring the bell. Ding, ding! The truck is huge and fast.
Today, Jake and {{hero}} have a big job. They need to take a load of stones to the lake, so the kids can make a safe path to the beach by the end of the day.
On the way, it rains and rains. The road gets wet and muddy, and the big truck slides and gets stuck. The wheels spin, but the truck will not go. {{hero}} feels a bit sad.
Then {{hero}} spots a digger at the side of the road. The digger gives the truck a big push, and the truck rolls free. Jake and {{hero}} wave and shout, "Thank you!"

At last, the stones are at the lake, and the kids make the path. That night, {{hero}} sleeps and dreams of trucks. But Jake said, "Next time, we will take the truck to a place no one has seen." What will they find?
